verses.en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
verses.sm: O LE sefulu ma le lua o tausaga o Aasa le tupu o Iuta na fai ai Hosea le atalii o Ele ma tupu o Isaraelu i Samaria i tausaga e iva.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.sm: Na ia faia foi le amio leaga i luma o Ieova, a e lei ausia amio a tupu o Isaraelu e na muamua ia te ia.

verses.en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
verses.sm: Ua sii mai le taua ia te ia e Salemanesa le tupu o Asuria, ua faitoilalo foi Hosea ia te ia, ma ua fai taulaga i ai.

verses.en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.sm: A ua iloa e le tupu o Asuria o Hosea a fouvale, auā na na auina le sāvali ia So le tupu o Aikupito, ua na le avane foi le taulaga i le tupu o Asuria, faapei o lea tausaga ma lea tausaga; o le mea lea na puipui ai ia te ia e le tupu o Asuria, ma na fusifusi ia te ia i le fale puipui.

verses.en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.sm: Ona alu ae lea o le tupu o Asuria i le nuu uma, ua alu ae lava i Samaria, ua sio ai i tausaga e tolu.

verses.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.sm: O le iva o tausaga o Hosea na aea āi Samaria e le tupu o Asuria, ua na faatāfeaina foi Isaraelu i Asuria, ma tuuina atu ia te i latou i Hala ma Havoli e lata ane i le vaitafe o Kosane, atoa ma aai o Metai.

verses.en: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
verses.sm: Na oo ia mea ina ua agasala le fanauga a Isaraelu ia Ieova lo latou Atua, o le na aveina ae ia te i latou ai le nuu o Aikupito ai lalo o le lima o Farao le tupu o Aikupito, ma ua latou matatau i atua ese.

verses.en: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
verses.sm: Ua savavali foi i tu a nuu ese sa tulia e ieova i luma o le fanauga a Isaraelu, atoa ma tu a tupu o Isaraelu sa latou faia.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.sm: Na fai faalilolilo e le fanauga a Isaraelu mea e le tusa ia Ieova lo latou Atua; na latou faia foi mo i latou mea maualuluga i o latou aai uma, o le pae o tagata leoleo atoa ma le aai nofo ‘olo.

verses.en: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
verses.sm: Ua latou faatuina foi mo i latou tupua ma tupua o Asaira i luga i mauga maualuluga uma, ma lalo o laau lauolaola uma.

verses.en: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:
verses.sm: Ua latou faamu ai mea manogi i mea maualuluga uma, faapei o nuu ese e ua faatāfea e ieova i o latou luma, ua latou faia

verses.en: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
verses.sm: foi mea leaga e faaonoono atu ai ia Ieova; auā ua latou auauna i tupua, o le mea na fetalai mai ai Ieova ia

verses.en: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
verses.sm: ITa aoai mai lava ieova ia Isaraelu atoa ma Iuta e le au perofeta uma, ma tagata vaai uma, ua faapea mai, Ia outou liliu mai i o outou ala leaga, ma ia outou tausi i a‘u poloaiga ma a‘u sauniga, ia tusa ma le tulafono uma na ou poloai atu ai i o outou tamā, na ou tuuina atu ai foi ia te outou e a‘u auauna o le au perofeta.

verses.en: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.
verses.sm: A ua latou le faalogo lava, a e peitai ua latou faamaaa i o latou ua, faapei o ua o latou tamā, o e na le talitonu ia ieova lo latou Atua.

verses.en: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.
verses.sm: Ua latou tiai foi ana sauniga ma lana feagaiga na osi ma o latou tamā, atoa foi ma ana tulafono na ia fetalai mai ai ia te i latou; ua latou mulimuli atu foi i le mea faatauvaa, ona amio faatauvaa ai lea o i latou; ua faaa‘oa‘o foi i nuu ese na vagavagaia i latou, na poloai mai ai Ieova ia te i latou, Aua ne‘i faia faapei o i latou.

verses.en: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
verses.sm: Ua latou tuua foi poloaiga uma a Ieova lo latou Atua, ua latou faia foi mo i latou tupua uamea, o tamai povi e lua; ua latou fai foi le tupua o Asaira, ua latou ifo foi i ‘au uma o le lagi, ma latou auauna ia Paala.

verses.en: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
verses.sm: Ua latou faaui ane o latou atalii ma o latou afafine i le afi, ua latou fai togafiti faataulāitu foi, ma saili faailoga; ua matuā tuuina atu foi i latou e i latou ia fai amio leaga i luma o Ieova e faaonoono atu ai ia te ia.

verses.en: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.sm: O le mea lea na matuā toasa mai ai ieova ia Isaraelu, ua ia ave ese ai ia te i latou i ona luma; e leai se na toe, na o le itu aiga lava o Iuta.

verses.en: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
verses.sm: O Iuta foi na le tausi i poloaiga a ieova lo latou Atua, a ua latou savavali i tu a Isaraelu na latou faia.

verses.en: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
verses.sm: Ona lafoai ai lea e ieova o le fanau uma a Isaraelu, ma ia faapuapuagatia i latou, ua na tuuina foi i latou i lima o e na vete ia te i latou, ina seia oo ina Lafoaiina i latou uma e ia.

verses.en: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.
verses.sm: Auā na ia vavaeeseina Isaraelu ai le aiga o Tavita; ona latou fai ai lea mo latou tupu o Ierepoamo le atalii o Nepata; ua mimilo ese foi e Ierepoamo ia Isaraelu ne‘i latou mulimuli atu ia Ieova, na ia faatupu ia te i latou le agasala tele.

verses.en: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
verses.sm: Na savavali foi le fanauga a Isaraelu i agasala uma a Ierepoamo na

verses.en: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.
verses.sm: Ua oo ina tuueseina e ieova ia Isaraelu ai ona luma, e tusa ma lana afioga i ana auauna uma le au perofeta. O lea na faatāfeaina ai Isaraelu ai lo latou nuu i Asuria, ua oo mai lava i le aso nei.

verses.en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
verses.sm: Ona au mai ai lea e le tupu o Asuria o tagata mai Papelonia, ma Kuta, ma Ava, ma Amato, atoa foi ma Sefavaima, ua tuu atu i iatou i aai o Samaria, o sui o le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua latou fai mo i latou o Samaria, ma latou nonofo i ona aai.

verses.en: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.
verses.sm: O le amataga o lo latou nonofo i lea nuu ua latou le matatau ai ia Ieova; ona aauina atu ai lea e Ieova o leona ia te i latou, na oti ai nisi o i latou.

verses.en: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.
verses.sm: Ona lātou ta4u atu ai lea i le tupu o Asuria, ua faapea atu, O nuu na e avea, ma tuuina i aai o Samaria, ua latou le iloa le tu a le Atua o le nuu; o lea ua aauina mai ai e ia o leona ia te i latou, faauta foi, ua oti ai ō latou, auā ua latou le iloa le tu a le Atua o le nuu.

verses.en: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o le tupu o Asuria, ua faapea mai, Ina avatu ia le tasi o le au ositaulaga na outou aumaia i lea nuu, latou te o e nonofo ai, na te a‘oa‘o atu ia te i latou i le tua le Atua o le nuu.

verses.en: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth-el, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu ai lea o le tasi o le au ositaulaga na latou aumaia mai Samaria, ua nofo i Peteli, ma a‘oa‘o atu ia te i latou i le uiga o le mata‘u ia Ieova.

verses.en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.
verses.sm: A ua taitasi le nuu ma fai o latou lava atua, ma tuu ai i fale o i mea maualuluga sa faia e tagata Samaria, taitasi le nuu ma fai ai i a latou aai na latou nonofo ai.

verses.en: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.sm: Na faia e tagata Papelonia o Suko-peno, na faia foi e tagata Kuta o Nekala, na faia foi e tagata Amato o Asima,

verses.en: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.sm: na faia e tagata Ava o Niveasa ma Tareaka, o tagata o Sefavaima foi na latou susunu i a latou fanau i le afi mo Atameleko ma Anameleko, o atua ia o Sefavaima.

verses.en: So they feared the LORD, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
verses.sm: Na latou matatau ia Ieova, ma fai foi mo i latou o ositaulaga i mea maualuluga mai le nuu uma, na latou ositaulaga mo i latou i fale o i mea maualuluga.

verses.en: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
verses.sm: Na latou matatau ia Ieova, a e auauna foi i o latou lava atua, faapei o tu a nuu e na faatāfeaina i latou nai lea mea.

verses.en: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
verses.sm: Ua oo lava i le aso nei o latou o fai faapei o tu tuai. Latou te le matatau ia Ieova; latou te le fai foi faapei o a latou tu, ma a latou sauniga, ma le tulafono, ma le poloaiga na poloai mai ai Ieova i le fanauga a Iakopo, na ia faaigoaina o Isaraelu.

verses.en: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:
verses.sm: Na osi foi e ieova le feagaiga ma i latou, ma na poloai mai ai ia te i latou, ua faapea mai, Aua tou te matatau i atua ese, aua tou te ifo ia te i latou, aua tou te auauna i ai, aua foi tou te ositaulaga ia te i latou.

verses.en: But the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.
verses.sm: A o Ieova, o le na aveina ae ia te outou ai le nuu o Aikupito i le mana tele ma le aao faaloaloa, tou te matatau ia te ia, tou te ifo ia te ia, tou te ositaulaga foi ia te ia.

verses.en: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.
verses.sm: O sauniga foi, ma tu, ma le tulafono, ma le poloaiga na ia tusi mai mo outou, tou te tausi i ai ia faia i aso uma; aua foi tou te matatau i atua ese.

verses.en: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.
verses.sm: O le feagaiga foi na ou osia ma outou, aua ne‘i galo lea ia te outou; aua foi tou te matatau i atua ese.

verses.en: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
verses.sm: A e peitai o Ieova lo outou Atua ia outou matatau i ai; ona laveai lea o ia ia te outou i lima o i latou uma lava o e ita mai ia te outou.

verses.en: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
verses.sm: A e lei faalogo lava i latou, a e peitai ua latou faia lava faapei o a latou tu tuai.

verses.en: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
verses.sm: O lea na matatau ai ia nuu ia ieova, a e auauna foi i a latou tupua ua ta. O a latou fanau foi, ma fanau a latou fanau, faapei ona faia e o latou tamā e faapea ona faia e i latou, uā oo mai lava i le aso nei. 0 le tala i mea nafaia i le nofoaiga
